Mira and Theo walk across an old stone bridge over a misty river at night, the lantern glowing silver, moon above.
Thick fog rolls onto the far end of the bridge, the street lamps flicker and go out one by one.
The shadow dissolves into the fog, the street lamps on the bridge flicker back on one by one.
They arrive at the old library at night, the doors open by themselves with warm golden light.
An empty space on a high archive shelf where one jar is missing, dust outlining a circle, a faint name plate scratched away.
The silver light inside the lantern draws a tiny shape: two hands, one big and one small, holding each other.
Wide shot of the archive, all the jars glow a little brighter together, warm and hopeful.
